name: session
description: What a session left behind and a safety net: a /session pane with files changed, commits, denied calls and the longest gap, a retro band on the next start, a safe stop for stray claude -p children, guards that confirm destructive commands and secret-file writes, /memo notes pinned to the model's context, /smart-compact (recap at a set context %, then compact), /handoff, /recap and /lessons from that recap, a /task timer and the session cost in the status line, a /board of every open session with its harness, graph and teams runs, and a message to the other sessions of a repo when main moves.

guard_mode.title: Guard mode
guard_mode.description: What to do when a command or write hits a guard rule: confirm (ask the person), deny (block, no ask), off.

guard_extra_protected_branches.title: Extra protected branches
guard_extra_protected_branches.description: Comma-separated branch names a force push is stopped on, besides main, master, trunk and the remote default.

guard_secret_paths.title: Extra secret paths
guard_secret_paths.description: Comma-separated globs (for example secrets/**) a write is stopped on, besides .env files, keys and credential files.

log_enabled.title: Denial log
log_enabled.description: Keep a redacted log of denied calls for /session-denials.

smart_compact_threshold.title: Smart compact threshold (%)
smart_compact_threshold.description: Context usage % at which the session is recapped and then compacted with that recap (10-95). Also set with /smart-compact <n>.

cost_budget_usd.title: Cost budget (USD)
cost_budget_usd.description: One toast when this session's cost reaches it; 0 turns it off.

prompt_hint.title: Prompt hint
prompt_hint.description: A toast when a short task prompt names no scope or check (never changes the prompt).
